extensionName.description: Extension name in the toolbar and the store.

extensionDescription.message: Types the verification code from your newest Gmail message into the page you are on. Read-only, and nothing leaves your browser.

actionTitle.message: Q-Fill: fill the code from Gmail

commandFill.message: Fill the newest code from Gmail

setupLead.message: Q-Fill reads Gmail with your own Google OAuth client, so no one else ever holds a key to your inbox. It takes about five minutes, once.

setupStep1.message: Create a Google Cloud project and turn on the Gmail API.

setupStep2.message: Create an OAuth client of type Web application and add this redirect URI:

setupStep3.message: Paste the client ID it gives you:

clientIdInvalid.message: That does not look like a client ID. It ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com.

connectLead.message: Q-Fill asks Google for read-only access. It can never send, change or delete mail, and codes never leave your browser.

connectHint.message: A Google window opens. Pick your account and allow “View your email messages and settings”.

fillHint.message: Open the page that asks for a code, then press Fill. If the email has not arrived yet, Q-Fill waits for it.

phaseWaitingDetail.message: Checking every few seconds for $SECONDS$ more seconds. You can close this window.

resultNoField.message: No code field on this page. Copy the code and paste it yourself.

resultRejected.message: The page did not accept the code. Copy it and paste it yourself.

resultBlocked.message: This page does not allow extensions. Copy the code and paste it yourself.

resultGone.message: The tab was closed before the code arrived.

resultNone.message: No verification email in the last $MINUTES$ minutes.

resultNoneHint.message: Check the code was sent to this Gmail address, or look further back in Settings.

settingsLookbackHint.message: Q-Fill only uses codes from emails this recent.

toastNoField.message: Found $CODE$ but no code field here. Copy it from the Q-Fill popup.

toastRejected.message: Found $CODE$ but the page did not accept it. Copy it from the Q-Fill popup.

toastConnectFirst.message: Open Q-Fill from the toolbar to connect Gmail first.

errorNoClientId.message: Add your OAuth client ID first.

errorSignInCancelled.message: The Google window closed before sign-in finished. If Google showed redirect_uri_mismatch, add the redirect URI from Settings to your OAuth client.

errorAccessDenied.message: Google did not grant access. If your OAuth app is in testing, add your Gmail address as a test user.

errorScopeDenied.message: Allow “View your email messages and settings” on the Google screen. Q-Fill needs it to find codes.

errorSignInAgain.message: Your Google sign-in expired. Press Fill again to sign back in.

errorOffline.message: Could not reach Gmail. Check your internet connection.

errorGmailForbidden.message: Gmail refused the request. Make sure the Gmail API is turned on in your Google Cloud project.

errorRateLimited.message: Gmail asked Q-Fill to slow down. Try again in a minute.
